materials.title: 同源证据镜
materials.sequence: 全图给出处 → 标记关注区 → 同源局部放大 → 回到全图或延续标记
materials.implementation: FocusLens组件要求SVG源对象与clipId；图像放入同源坐标系后再使用。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 共基线图表／表格舞台
materials.sequence: 先呈现比较维度 → 突出当前论点的行或数据 → 留出查值 → 回收结论
materials.implementation: 选择SVG/D3或原生表格；几何和数值从同一数据计算，缺数据改用定性对照。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 关系线转地理路线
materials.sequence: 节点关系 → 地理锚点匹配 → 路径展开 → 全局定位
materials.implementation: TracePath只负责描线；地理投影和GeoJSON按数据实现，不从示意图猜坐标。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 机制对象流
materials.sequence: 起始状态 → 原句动词驱动变化 → 结果落定
materials.implementation: SharedElement承载对象，TracePath描关系；对象位置与因果依据由文案配置。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 证据拼贴层
materials.sequence: 主证据 → 次证据接入 → 关系标记 → 主论点聚焦
materials.implementation: TornMatte与MediaCard可作起点；边缘、卡片圆角、阴影需重设以匹配本片，原图与遮罩另提供。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 风格化原创图扩展
materials.sequence: 生成与核对 → 全图定位 → 遮罩揭示／平面运动 → 代码标记接入
materials.implementation: 用可用imagegen生成或编辑位图；原图无分层则采用平面运动，真实图层就绪才作视差。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 可辨识主体接力
materials.sequence: 先辨识 → 轮廓过渡 → 新状态稳定 → 后续使用
materials.implementation: morphContour是有限演示轮廓函数，不是任意SVG形变器；新形状匹配拓扑或用遮罩交接。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 产品／素材的空间聚焦
materials.sequence: 上下文 → 聚焦关键操作／细节 → 显示结果 → 拉回关系
materials.implementation: MediaCard和SharedElement实现有限2.5D起点；真实3D需模型、相机与验证，不把CSS透视称为真实三维。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds

materials.title: 声音与画面的共用事件表
materials.sequence: 事件时间 → 视觉动作 → 可选声音 → 同一锚点检查
materials.implementation: 将事件表接到场景与音轨；不附带第三方样本或默认配音，不以固定BPM改写旁白。
materials.ownership: Original recipe; no third-party media bundled
materials.timing: Choose durations from narration and actual reading/motion needs; no fixed seconds
